motion_rule: Envelopes and side characters rip past the lens nonstop; hero holds his spot to 8.20; one clear action per beat; head over a third of frame, new shot size each beat; motion across frame, never up-down
character: Fat rhesus macaque, tight vest over bare belly, black sleeve guards; centred, two thirds of frame height, one hand on the beam, pans held low at chest level, muzzle and jaw always clear.
second_characters: ONE rat loader in an apron (moves 3.25-4.10, 5.70-6.45); ONE monitor lizard courier on a roller cart (moves 4.10-4.95). Before 3.25 both stand still in the aisle.
props: ONE apothecary balance with two pans, held by the hero. A SWARM of identical envelope bundles, each tied crosswise with a white ribbon reading ДОЛГ in black capitals. Overhead belt sheds envelopes across frame into the lens.
prop_continuity: Bundles grow from a handful at 3.25 to heaps spilling over both rims by 7.25, equal left and right; the beam stays level; both pans stay on the balance until 8.20.
environment: Narrow postal sorting aisle, walls of stuffed sacks and envelope racks
light_events: Bright daylight from high windows, glints on the pans; a hard sun bar sweeps across them at 5.70 and again at 8.20

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: male voice, businesslike and pleased with himself, biting off each word, 4.5 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PROS-to, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON, dol-GI
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.15 and 1.15-3.25 each on one breath; no words after 3.25, sfx continue

timeline.a: jaw working, hero thrusts the balance sideways at the very lens.
jaw working, hero swings the beam wide side to side at the lens.
jaw working, hero turns the balance broadside across frame.
jaw working, hero shakes the left pan into the lens.
jaw working, hero shakes the right pan into the lens.
jaw wide open, hero sweeps both pans apart to the sides of frame, muzzle clear in the middle.
Rat loader sweeps left to right past the very lens, dumping a bundle into the left pan.
Lizard on the cart sweeps right to left past the very lens, tipping an identical bundle into the right pan.
Hero slams the loaded left pan flat against the lens, the ДОЛГ ribbon filling frame, then whips it back across frame.
Rat sweeps back tight against the lens, an identical ДОЛГ ribbon lashing the glass.
Hero rocks the balance like a pendulum across frame, both pans sweeping past the lens.
Hero rams the level beam broadside across frame at the lens, heaped pans equal on both sides.
Hero rips both loaded pans off the beam and hurls them left to right into the lens, the bare beam left in his fist.
Hero swipes backhanded with the bare beam right across frame into the lens.

must_appear: Both pans in his hands to 8.20; the ДОЛГ ribbons identical on both sides; the beam level to 8.20; every line spoken, last word by 3.25; after 8.20 he hurls the pans at the lens, bare beam in his hands.
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, digits, a price card, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters, slow motion, drawn-out delivery, foreign accent, two actions at once, a closed jaw while speaking, a tilted beam, an empty corridor, a still hero at the end, a second balance, frozen objects in mid-air, English speech
